tagline: Real stunts cut to a new moment every second: a cold open mid-action, glowing green money tags pinned to the cash, loud comic captions, a countdown clock, and an ending on the winner's face.
needs: a real stunt filmed on 2+ cameras: you, the people taking part, and the prize
readiness_note: Only works on your own stunt footage: shoot 2+ vertical 4K cameras, real money or prizes on camera, about 10 minutes of footage per minute of reel.

captions: Cold open: the host mid-stride with comic caps already on screen, a hard cut, then the stake
Money tag: a neon-green amount pinned to the open cash case, then the winner's yellow shout
Countdown clock: set time jumping down across hard cuts over the money pile
